import pytest
from apimd.parser import doctest

def test_doctest_wraps_single_example():
    input_doc = """This is a function.

>>> print('hello')
hello

End of doc."""
    expected = """This is a function.

```python
>>> print('hello')
hello
```
End of doc."""
    assert doctest(input_doc) == expected

def test_doctest_handles_multiple_examples_and_no_markers():
    input_doc = """Start
>>> a = 1
>>> b = 2
>>> a + b
3
Middle
>>> c = 3
End"""
    expected = """Start
```python
>>> a = 1
>>> b = 2
>>> a + b
3
```
Middle
```python
>>> c = 3
```
End"""
    assert doctest(input_doc) == expected

def test_doctest_with_no_doctest_lines_returns_original():
    input_doc = """Just a plain text without any doctest markers.
It should remain unchanged."""
    assert doctest(input_doc) == input_doc
